## Core Architecture — 3 Buses

```

                          │  Telegram Photo/Doc     Git (feature→staging→prod)  │
                          └───────┬──────────────────────────────┬─────────────┘

                                  ▼                                ▼
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║              GO CONTROL PLANE  (gc-orch :8721)  ~5MB                        ║
║  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌────────────┐ ║
║  │Telegram  │  │ A2A2A Bridge │  │ Queue    │  │Scheduler│  │ Monitor    │ ║
║  │Ingress   │─▶│ (11 agents   │◀▶│ P0-P3    │  │ (cron)  │  │ (health/   │ ║
║  │(bot API) │  │  real-time)  │  │ REST API │  │ 1h tick │  │  metrics)  │ ║
║  └────┬─────┘  └──────┬───────┘  └────┬─────┘  └────┬────┘  └─────┬──────┘ ║
╚═══════│═══════════════│═══════════════│══════════════│═════════════│════════╝
        │ spawn          │ IPC socket    │ enqueue      │ trigger     │ scrape
        ▼                ▼               ▼              ▼             ▼
┌──────────────┐  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
│ OCR WORKER   │  ║          RUST CORE  gc-runtime-core (steady ~2MB)        ║
│ (Rust, on-   │  ║  ┌────────┐ ┌───────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌─────────────┐     ║
│  demand)     │─▶║  │vector  │ │ rag   │ │ harness  │ │ store       │     ║
│ leptess      │  ║  │128-dim │▶│cosine │▶│eval+gap+ │▶│ JSON        │     ║
│ tha+eng      │  ║  │mmap f32│ │retrieve│ │improve   │ │ samples     │     ║
└──────────────┘  ║  └───┬────┘ └───┬────┘ └────┬─────┘ └──────┬──────┘     ║
                  ╚══════│══════════╪═══════════│══════════════╪════════════╝
                         │ embed    │ context   │ score        │ log
                   ┌─────▼──────────▼───────────▼──────────────▼──────┐
                   │      SELF-EVOLUTION DAEMON (Rust, 1MB, 1h tick)  │
                   │  scan→classify→propose→test→gate→commit(feature) │
                   └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────────┘
                                          ▼  git feature branch (no_push)
                              ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                              │ Maker-Gate (Rust pre-commit) │
                              │ tests + PRODUCT.md + lint    │
                              │ → staging → prod (manual)    │
                              └──────────────────────────────┘
```

### Data Flow (Closed Loop)
```
Telegram img/command → Go Ingress → OCR → vector.embed → rag.store
  → Agents query RAG for context → produce output
  → Harness.eval(agent output vs RAG) → score + gap
  → Self-Evolution reads gap every 1h → propose fix
  → Maker-Gate validates → feature branch → staging → prod
  → Agent v2 → re-evaluated → loop closes
```

## Migration Plan — 4 Phases (18 weeks)

### Phase 1 — Foundation & Queue Unification (Weeks 1-3)
| Week | Task | Agent | Deliverable |
|------|------|-------|-------------|
| W1 | **P0**: Merge bash queue → gc-orch Go REST | Hermes + Go | Single queue endpoint, shim deprecated |
| W2 | **P1**: PRODUCT.md for 4 agents + unit tests | Claude + Planner | Baseline complete |
| W3 | **P2**: Commit 169 files with safety scan | OpenCode | Clean branch, maker-gate active |

### Phase 2 — Python→Rust/Go Migration (Weeks 4-7)
| Week | Task | Agent | Deliverable |
|------|------|-------|-------------|
| W4 | Classify 2,107 .py files → keep/migrate/delete | OpenCode + zcode | Classification report |
| W5 | Migrate gc-rag-harness.py → Rust rag.rs + harness.rs | Claude + Rust | Python-free RAG loop |
| W6 | Convert 5 .sh scripts → Rust/Go subcommands | Hermes + Go | Script layer eliminated |
| W7 | Remove Python dependency, regression tests | OpenCode | Python deps removed |

### Phase 3 — Node→Go Migration (Weeks 8-12)
| Week | Task | Agent | Deliverable |
|------|------|-------|-------------|
| W8-9 | Map 120 Node modules → Go endpoints | zcode + Go | Migration map |
| W10-11 | Strangler pattern porting | Hermes + Go | Dual-run verification |
| W12 | Cut Node, gc-orch 100% traffic | OpenCode | Node-free control plane |

### Phase 4 — TS Migration + Self-Evolution + OCR (Weeks 13-18)
| Week | Task | Agent | Deliverable |
|------|------|-------|-------------|
| W13-14 | Classify 5,474 .ts files | zcode | TS migration plan |
| W15 | Self-Evolution daemon GA | Rust | 1h autonomous evolution |
| W16 | Telegram OCR pipeline GA | Rust + Go | Image→text→RAG pipeline |
| W17 | Harness GA — 11 agents in dashboard | Go + Rust | Real-time agent metrics |
| W18 | Freeze + regression + staging promotion | All | System complete |

## Resource Budget

| Component | RAM idle | RAM peak | Binary | Note |
|-----------|----------|----------|--------|------|
| gc-runtime-core | 2.0 MB | 3.0 MB | 1.6 MB | Existing |
| Self-Evolution daemon | 1.0 MB | 2.5 MB | +0.4 MB | New in gc-neural |
| gc-orch (Bridge+Queue+Monitor) | 5.0 MB | 6.0 MB | 8.0 MB | Existing |
| Telegram Ingress | 2.0 MB | 2.5 MB | +1.5 MB | Merge into gc-orch |
| **Total steady-state** | **10.0 MB** | **~14 MB** | **11.5 MB** | **<15 MB target ✅** |
| OCR Worker (ephemeral) | 0 MB | 40-60 MB | 3 MB | Spawn→OCR→exit, RSS returned |

## Safety Architecture

| Safety Layer | Mechanism | Scope |
|-------------|-----------|-------|
| git no_push | `push_url=no_push` on staging remote | Prod protection |
| Maker-Gate | Pre-commit: tests+PRODUCT.md+lint | Code quality |
| Feature flags | `EVOLVE_ENABLED`, `OCR_ENABLED` | Runtime gating |
| Confidence gate | OCR mean-conf ≥ 0.75 auto, < 0.75 human | Data quality |
| Strangler pattern | Old system kept 1 week before deletion | Backup safety |
| Monitor alerts | RAM >14MB, error rate, harness score drop | Auto-freeze evolve |
| Rollback | Git revert + feature flag + <5 min recovery | Every phase |

## Success Criteria

- [ ] All 11 agents have PRODUCT.md + unit tests
- [ ] Single unified queue (bash queue retired)

- [ ] 169 files committed safely
- [ ] Self-Evolution daemon running 1h tick
